table.name: TLGNR_PDA_SESSION_STATUS_BS
table.description: Status of a PDA session. During the login/setup phase it is on 'initializing' (not yet ready to receive events), normally goes into 'ready', and finishes as 'terminated' by a timeout or logout by the user. Special error state(s) can be defined in addition (TODO: Add if needed based on experiences in real life).

column.name: PDA_SESSION_STATUS_CD
column.description: PK. 1=initializing (PDA not yet ready to receive messages from Logon), 2=ready, 3=terminated, 4=error

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
